title: Codex accounts
intro: Manage Codex accounts and quotas without VS Code. Ordinary ChatGPT chat accounts are separate.
cliMissing: Install supported Codex CLI {{version}} to enable account operations.
desktopUnverified: Windows desktop switching is experimental; live compatibility has not yet been verified.
loginPending: Finish sign-in in the official browser window. You can cancel here.
automationHint: Checks run every five minutes while VibeHub is running, with at least ten minutes between switches. An open desktop app waits for your restart confirmation.
emptyHint: Sign in or import your local Codex account to get started.
quotaUnknown: Quota information is unknown. Refresh to check.
restartConfirm: Finish ongoing work first. Confirming closes the desktop app normally, switches the Codex account and reopens it. If the app cannot close normally, switching stops.
deleteConfirm: Remove this saved account from VibeHub? The local signed-in Codex session is kept.

errors.cliMissing: Supported Codex CLI was not found.
errors.protocol: The app service returned an unsupported response.
errors.storage: Account data could not be saved or read.
errors.credentialInvalid: The local Codex OAuth credential is missing or invalid.
errors.storageUnsupported: This credential storage format is unsupported.
errors.configuration: The account or setting conflicts with Codex configuration requirements.
errors.unknownAccount: This saved account no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.busy: Another account operation is in progress.
errors.requestFailed: The operation failed. Check your connection and sign-in, then retry.
errors.timeout: Codex did not respond in time.
errors.loginFailed: Sign-in failed or expired. Start again.
errors.loginRequired: Sign in again to refresh this account.
errors.tooMany: Up to 16 accounts can be saved.
errors.externalChanged: Codex credentials changed outside VibeHub. Reload and review the active account.
errors.switchFailed: Codex rejected the new account. The previous account was restored.
errors.rollbackFailed: Credential recovery failed. Stop account operations and sign in to Codex again.
errors.browser: The sign-in browser window could not be opened.
errors.invalidName: Enter a name between 1 and 120 characters.
errors.desktopAmbiguous: Multiple or unrecognized Codex desktop installations are running. Close them before switching.
errors.restartFailed: The Codex account changed, but the desktop app could not reopen. Start it manually.
errors.jsonInvalid: Invalid Codex account JSON or file exceeds the size limit.
errors.unsupportedApp: Account integration is not available for this app.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This app version has not been verified for account switching.
errors.identityMismatch: The service returned a different account. No switch was accepted.
errors.signInInApp: Sign in to the desired account in the original app, then refresh here.
errors.closeRequired: Quit the original app, including its tray process, then try again.
errors.network: The account service could not be reached.
errors.notFound: The saved account was not found.
errors.browserPreview: Browser preview cannot read real desktop accounts.
errors.switchUnverified: Account detection is verified. Switching awaits a real two-account round-trip test on this version.
errors.balanceUnavailable: The remaining balance could not be verified. Granted quota is shown separately.
errors.restartRequired: Confirm closing and restarting the original app before switching.
errors.unsupportedProvider: This ZCode connection supports ZAI sign-in. The active sign-in provider is different.

notices.externalChanged: Codex credentials changed outside VibeHub. Reload and review the active account.
notices.loginFailed: Sign-in failed or expired. Start again.
notices.restartRequired: A Codex account switch is waiting for your restart confirmation.
notices.switched: The local Codex account was switched.
notices.noCandidate: No other account has fresh, sufficient quota. The active account was kept.

adapterPendingHint: Automatic account detection, JSON import and quota switching are not connected for this app yet. Codex credentials cannot be used for this app.
initialRead: On first use, VibeHub reads your current local Codex account and saves it as the first profile without changing the signed-in account.
jsonHint: Choose a Codex auth.json file (up to 256 KB). It is read only by the native backend, stored encrypted, and is not activated automatically.
browserAccountsTitle: Real accounts are available in the desktop app
browserAccountsHint: This browser preview cannot access your accounts or Windows credential store. Open VibeHub — Development and go to Codex accounts to detect your current account. An empty preview does not mean no account exists on this computer.
desktopAccountsHint: The current signed-in account is read locally. To add another account, sign in through the original app, then refresh here.
versionReadOnly: Installed version {{version}}. Account switching is enabled only for verified version {{supported}}.
captureAfterLogin: Sign in through the original app, then refresh to add the current account.
grantedNotRemaining: Granted entitlements; this is not the remaining token balance.
switchConfirm: Switch the original app to this saved account?
desktopDeleteConfirm: Remove this saved profile? The signed-in account in the original app stays signed in.
desktopRestartConfirm: Finish ongoing work first. Confirming closes the original app normally, changes its account and reopens it.
